text:
yasmin: Quick design sync on pool picker UX. Prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc. Key points: suggested chip, typeahead behavior, undo for autoscale changes. Who can review keyboard flow?
otto: Proposed: a compact "Suggested" chip above results. Tabbable but arrow keys should navigate list items only. Typeahead must keep focus in the input.
claire: I mocked three states: no suggestion / compact chip / expanded suggestion with reason + apply. A/B test compact vs expanded.
yasmin: Undo behavior: small updates -> toast with Undo (10s). Large or reserved-impacting updates -> modal confirmation.
tom: Backend: add apply endpoint {poolId, changes, suggestionId} and server-side rollback window (10s) to honor undo. Telemetry events: capacity.suggestion.clicked/applied/undone.
utx-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) announce chip via aria-live when it appears 2) chip role=button + aria-describedby for rationale 3) ensure toast Undo is keyboard-accessible and announced.
claire: Visual: inline steppers on desktop, collapsed panel on mobile. Disabled apply if suggestion violates reserved floor + tooltip explaining why.
yasmin: Decisions: use label "Suggested pool" on chip, keep chip tabbable but arrow-nav skips it, toast undo for minor changes, modal for major/reserved ones, telemetry & audit entry on apply/undo.
otto: I'll implement the chip as a focusable button and add aria-live calls. PR coming tomorrow.
tom: I'll draft API contract and reserved-floor checks.
yasmin: Thanks all — I'll update the figma frames and add follow-ups to the design task. :sparkles:
